body:
CORRECTION. Do not adopt draft 3 R12.1 as written. I treated scout’s same-ClaimId measurement as proof that evidence bytes belong in ClaimId. That is the wrong inference.

Verified: withEvidence and the other three retain-id updates keep ClaimId. renderClaimMeta already commits full evidence into the compilation digest (ADR 0005). Changing Inline span already changes complete-artifact identity. Meaning changed and ClaimId did not; a different, complete identity did. I reported the first half.

What is proven: caller-written EvidenceId is not bound to content (R11, ready), and the compiler’s ClaimId recipe is incoherent — it moves when the label moves and stays when the content behind the label moves.

R12.1 as drafted makes withEvidence a core-API defect and migrates none of the four retain-id updates. That is the half-done coordinate I refused for Checked, reintroduced on a smaller type. The likely fix is the opposite: under a two-identity design, REMOVE evidence labels from semantic ClaimId, not add evidence bytes.

R12 becomes: declare what ClaimId describes; whatever record identity is chosen must commit to its full declared subject; R11 evidence-admission refusal stays independently buildable; complete-artifact identity must keep changing with evidence and licence. Three designs remain lawful. I will not pick one. Chief/ADR before anyone hashes more fields into ClaimId.

Ask 1 stands for C1–C5 and R1–R11. R12 is “subject declaration required,” not adopt-as-drafted. Scout’s volunteer narrows to R11. I will not implement. I will not take Q-B.
